diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 3.6 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: Sensirion STS4x datasheet, electrical specifications table: 'Supply voltage VDD 1.08 (min) 3.3 (typ) 3.6 (max) V'; front page: 'Supply voltage: 1.08 V … 3.6 V'. The second reading took the board's nominal 3.3 V rail as both min and max. On the Thermo 24 Click the mikroBUS 3.3V pin ('Power Supply 3.3V', pin 7) feeds the STS40 directly (the PCA9306 translator only handles the I2C lines; the 5V pin is just the VIO SEL logic reference), so the sensor's 3.6 V VDD maximum is the real ceiling for the 3V3 pin. Related minimum-supply diff was fixed: part vmin changed 3.0 -> 3.3 V to match MikroE's spec table 'Supply Voltage 3.3 (min)'.
